bio.text: Jim Himes represents Connecticut's 4th District in the U.S. House of Representatives, where he is serving his ninth term, and is Ranking Member of the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence.
Born in Lima, Peru, in 1966 to American parents, he moved to the United States at age ten, attended Harvard University, and studied at Oxford University as a Rhodes Scholar.
He worked at Goldman Sachs for 12 years and later ran the New York City office of Enterprise Community Partners, and he lives in Greenwich.
